messages:
Maya: Heads-up — CrescentAI showing a sharp drop in API usage starting 2024-06-21. Their main advocate (Nina) moved roles last week and procurement says they're evaluating VendorX. Can we triage?
Jon: Ack. Do we have token counts and which endpoints dropped?
Maya: Quick numbers from the dashboard: 
```
Last 7d tokens: 23,400
Prev 7d tokens: 128,900
Top endpoints impacted: /generate (-74%), /embeddings (-62%)
Active seats: 8 -> 5 (license pause)
```
Maya: Their success playbook was the embed indexing batch job + chat assistants. Both job runs stopped after the advocate change.
Sam: Probable causes: 1) lost champion, 2) procurement cost pressure, 3) they hit latency spikes on long sequences last month. I can pull traces for two timed-out /generate requests.
Priya: Onboarding checklist shows 3 outstanding items: SSO test, KV cache tuning, and dedicated batch window config. I flagged the integration ticket yesterday.
Jon: Proposed rescue: 1) offer a 30d dedicated trial (no commit) focused on embeds throughput, 2) a small bill credit for the week they lost traffic, 3) schedule a 30m reinstatement call with the new PM.
Maya: Customer asked for concise ROI numbers to present to procurement — can someone estimate token cost delta vs VendorX if they stay with our optimized batching?
Sam: From logs: avg seq len 850 tokens, steady-state QPS ~0.6 during business hours. Rough calc: our batched run w/ KV caching cost ≈ $0.0036/token-equivalent. VendorX listed price ≈ $0.0055/token. If they keep volume that's ~20% monthly spend difference. I'll add a short chart for the customer note.
OpsBot: Alert: account signal flagged — usage drop >60% and advocate change detected. Playbook suggested: "rescue outreach".
Maya: I'll draft outreach (short email + 1-slide ROI). Jon — can you own procurement slide? Priya — can you confirm if we can enable a temporary dedicated pool next week? Sam — assemble traces + latency fix recommendations.
Jon: On it. One-pager by EOD.
Priya: Checking infra availability now. If approved, we can enable a 1-week dedicated pool starting Monday.
Sam: Will gather traces and two-line remediation (KV tuning + quantization profile).
Maya: Sync at 11:30 PT tomorrow. If ROI slide + infra confirm before then, I'll loop in the new PM and procurement.
Jon: Also propose a live demo: fix their slow query in <30s to show value.
Maya: Agreed. Tagging @ProcurementTeam in follow-up.
Maya: Action items -> Jon: ROI slide; Priya: infra enablement; Sam: traces + remediation; Maya: outreach + meeting invite.
Sam: +1.
Maya: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
